title: Scent layering line-up
description: Opens on all the products standing together under a two-line hook, then shows them one by one in a hand over a white sheet, each with a small name label that changes its place above the product. Music only, eight seconds, made to loop.

shots.still_prompt: A phone photograph at arm's length of a cream vanity by a window in soft daylight. {all_products} stand close together in a loose group, every label facing the camera. A round mirror with a scalloped white frame at the upper left, a small dish with gold jewellery at the right. The middle band of the picture is calm enough to carry two lines of small white text. Airy bedroom, natural colours, vertical 9:16, no people, no text.
shots.motion_prompt: A short handheld phone clip that starts on this exact picture. The camera eases a few centimetres toward the products with the slight sway of a phone in one hand. The products do not move, and every cap and printed label stays crisp and exactly as it is. The daylight stays soft and even. A single continuous take without any text.
shots.action: All the products stand together on a vanity

shots.still_prompt: A phone photograph looking straight down at a bed with a crumpled white cotton sheet. A woman's hand with short natural nails and a thin gold ring comes in from the left and holds {product_1} upright in the lower two thirds of the picture, its label to the camera. The top quarter of the picture is empty sheet. Soft daylight, vertical 9:16, no text.
